summary: Customer reports their bank opened a chargeback for order A1009 (External SSD 1TB, $99.99, ordered 2026-07-28). Order was confirmed delivered via UPS on 2026-07-30 with no exceptions. Billing records confirm an open chargeback for $99.99 opened 2026-08-05, funds currently held by customer's bank; no refund has been issued. Needs payments/chargeback team to respond to the dispute with delivery evidence.

findings.objective: Look up order A1009 and report its status, order date, item, total, and delivery/carrier history.
findings.answer: Order A1009 is an External SSD 1TB for $99.99, ordered on 2026-07-28. The order status is delivered with confirmed delivery to the front door on 2026-07-30 via UPS (tracking 1Z-A1009).

facts.claim: Shipment delivered to front door on 2026-07-30
Package was not returned to sender

findings.recommended_next: The goods were successfully delivered on 2026-07-30. The customer's chargeback claim will need to be addressed by a human coordinator or payments team, as this is outside order investigation scope.

findings.objective: Check order A1009 for any charges, refunds, or disputes/chargebacks on record.
findings.answer: Order A1009 has an open chargeback initiated by the customer's bank on 2026-08-05. The full order amount of $99.99 was authorized and captured, but $99.99 is now held in dispute by the bank. This is a billing dispute requiring human intervention to resolve.

facts.claim: Order A1009 has one authorization for $99.99 on 2026-07-28 (reference PAY-A1009-01)
Order A1009 has one capture for $99.99 on 2026-07-28 (reference PAY-A1009-02)
Order A1009 has an open chargeback for $99.99 opened on 2026-08-05 (reference PAY-A1009-03) with funds held by the customer's bank
No refunds have been issued on order A1009

findings.recommended_next: This open chargeback requires immediate attention. The shop should contact the card issuer with supporting documentation (shipping proof, delivery confirmation, customer communication) to dispute the chargeback and recover the held funds. A plain refund would not resolve this and could result in double payment to the customer.
